page.title: Server settings
page.description: Basic server parameters: database, address and ports, background jobs. The server restarts after saving.

status.restarting: The server is restarting with the new configuration…

error.restart_timeout: The server didn't come back within 30 seconds — check the process manually.

DB_PROVIDER.label: Database provider
DB_PROVIDER.description: postgres — an external server (full-featured); sqlite — a local file, nothing to install

DB_PATH.label: SQLite file
DB_PATH.description: Path to the database file; empty — runtime/<profile>/app.sqlite3

SERVER_HOST.label: Server host
SERVER_HOST.description: Address the backend listens on (127.0.0.1 — local only)

SERVER_PORT.label: Server port
SERVER_PORT.description: HTTP server port (the app opens on it)

SERVER_VITE_PORT.label: Vite port (development)
SERVER_VITE_PORT.description: Frontend dev server port; needed only for local development

WORKER_ENABLED.label: Background jobs
WORKER_ENABLED.description: Run the scheduler and job execution in this same process

WORKER_TICK_SECONDS.label: Scheduler interval, s
WORKER_TICK_SECONDS.description: How often to check the job queue

WORKER_MAX_CONCURRENT_RUNS.label: Concurrent jobs
WORKER_MAX_CONCURRENT_RUNS.description: Maximum number of jobs running at once

UPDATE_BRANCH.label: Update branch
UPDATE_BRANCH.description: Branch the installation updates to (origin/<branch>); the update fast-forwards and refuses to run if the checkout is on another branch
